old: District government guideline, verbatim: 'The laboratory construction period is no more than 3 years; first-year support is no more than CNY 27,000,000, spent on compute rental, related configuration and operations. The laboratory compute serves no fewer than 30 quality projects or talent teams each year and must convert at least 8 into companies.' Eligibility, verbatim: 'The project founder or individual must meet at least one of: 1. a QS top-200 university background; 2. work experience at a leading domestic or overseas big-tech firm; 3. work experience at a star startup valued above CNY 1 billion or an AI unicorn; 4. fine-tuning experience on 8 or more GPUs; 5. an existing product demo plus open-source contribution, such as a GitHub or Hugging Face project with at least 100 stars; 6. backing from multiple investors.'
new: District government guideline, verbatim from the underlying scheme: 算力实验室建设项目周期不超过3年，第一年支持资金不超过2700万元，资金应用于算力租赁、关联配置以及运维服务，为前置支持。算力实验室算力每年用于不少于30个优质项目或优秀人才团队使用，培育转化不少于8家企业。 Eligibility is a credential screen: 1.QS200高校背景； 2.有国内外头部大厂相关工作经验； 3.有明星初创公司（估值10亿人民币以上）、AI相关独角兽企业（成立不到10年但估值10亿美元以上且未在股票市场上市的科技创业公司）工作经验； 4.有8卡以上模型微调经验； 5.已有产品demo，积极参与开源社区贡献，如在GitHub或Hugging Face等开源社区具有至少100+Star的开源项目； 6.项目获得多家资本青睐。

evidence.proved: the laboratory compute serves at least 30 projects or talent teams each year and must convert at least 8 companies
evidence.quote: 算力实验室算力每年用于不少于30个优质项目或优秀人才团队使用，培育转化不少于8家企业。

reason: The parent's quote was a reporting-progress sentence; the scheme page's support-measure sentence states the budget, term, service and conversion numbers, and separate numbered rows state eligibility.

evidence.proved: the laboratory support measure and its figures are unchanged
evidence.quote: 算力实验室建设项目周期不超过3年，第一年支持资金不超过2700万元，资金应用于算力租赁、关联配置以及运维服务，为前置支持。算力实验室算力每年用于不少于30个优质项目或优秀人才团队使用，培育转化不少于8家企业。

old: The Hailo AI Software Suite, the Dataflow Compiler, HailoRT and the Model Zoo are free to a registered developer, and registration is a plain account signup. What is neither free nor rentable is the silicon: a Hailo-8, Hailo-8L, Hailo-10H or Hailo-15 device is a module or card the developer owns. Hailo publishes no hosted device pool, and the third-party free hub that used to execute Hailo models in the cloud, DeGirum AI Hub, ceased operations on 2026-08-01.
new: The software is free of charge and available under the EULA that you agreed to when signing up for the Developer Zone. No hosted device is offered on the Developer Zone sign-in page: Hailo accelerators are modules or cards the developer owns. DeGirum has ceased operations effective August 1, 2026, and AI Hub is being discontinued in full, including the Pro tier.

evidence.proved: Hailo staff state the software is free under the Developer Zone EULA
evidence.quote: The software is free of charge and available under the EULA that you agreed to when signing up for the Developer Zone.

reason: The parent's quote was a navigation menu with no free-tier sentence; the community staff answer states the free software, and the Developer Zone and DeGirum captures state the device and hosted-cloud situation.

evidence.proved: the free-software clause of the free tier is unchanged
evidence.quote: The software is free of charge and available under the EULA that you agreed to when signing up for the Developer Zone.

old: Batch 1 recorded harvis.dev as a perpetual free allowance at 1 GB-month storage, 100,000 requests a month and 50 deploys, anonymous, with the free step metered on stored bytes. The vendor's about page carries a reduction with a date, quoted: 'Each site can be up to 50 MB in total (until 2027 Jan 1st, after that the limit will be reduced), spread across up to 500 files.' The pricing page also states that crossing any one of four ceilings moves the whole account to the next paid step, quoted: 'Your account lands on the cheapest step that covers every one of them: cross a single ceiling and it moves up.'
new: harvis.dev (https://harvis.dev) is a free static-site hosting service. Publish with no account and no API key; upload limits are up to 50 MB and 500 files per site, static files only, and site files can be uploaded by HTTP POST to https://harvis.dev/api/upload. Bandwidth is not metered and never appears as a line.
